Are you ready to lead global network & security projects, from SD-WAN and Cisco infrastructure to firewall, WLAN and data centre implementations?

Are you an experienced Network & Security Specialist looking for a role that combines hands-on technical expertise, project ownership and international collaboration?

We are looking for a Group ICT Network & Security Project Specialist to join an international ICT infrastructure team in Groot-Bijgaarden.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end management and implementation of network and security projects, while also providing advanced support for a global IT environment serving approximately 9,000 users across 100+ sites worldwide.

You’ll work closely with network and security architects, regional and local IT teams, infrastructure specialists and external technology partners to ensure secure, reliable and high-performing connectivity.
Role
• Lead Network & Security Projects: Manage projects from the initial planning and budget phase through design, implementation, documentation and follow-up.
• Firewalling & Load Balancing: Troubleshoot, maintain and implement firewall and load-balancing solutions and features.
• LAN & WLAN: Install, configure and troubleshoot Cisco switching and wireless infrastructure across datacentres, offices, factories and remote sites.
• SD-WAN: Collaborate with global WAN providers to ensure reliable and performant connectivity across more than 100 locations.
• L2/L3 Support: Provide advanced operational support for complex networking and security issues, working directly or alongside local IT teams.
• Monitoring: Maintain and monitor network and security monitoring systems, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
• Technical Documentation: Interpret and maintain existing documentation and create technical/design documentation for new installations and projects.
• Infrastructure Installation: Support physical installations, including racking and stacking, initial equipment configuration, cabling and troubleshooting.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with infrastructure, security, HQ IT and local IT teams to ensure successful project delivery.
• Prioritisation: Balance project responsibilities with operational support and maintenance, ensuring business-critical activities receive the appropriate priority.
You’ll also participate in a 24/7 standby rotation for critical incidents, approximately once every 8 weeks.

Profile
We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on professional who enjoys solving complex problems and taking ownership of projects.
Required
• 5+ years of relevant experience in LAN/WAN, networking and/or security.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SD-WAN
• Firewall and Cloud Proxy technologies
• Cisco wired and wireless networking
• TCP/IP and OSI layers 1–7
• Switching and routing
• Wireless networking
• Firewall troubleshooting
• Experience managing network/security projects from planning through implementation.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
• Hands-on mentality with a proactive approach.
• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills.
• Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
• Stress-resistant and comfortable working in a global environment.Nice to have
Experience with:

• Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) or equivalent
• Cisco Nexus
• F5 Load Balancers
• Palo Alto Firewalls
• Sophos Firewalls
• Azure Network Fundamentals
• Wireless standards
• Monitoring technologies such as NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog and real-time alerts
• Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto, F5, or equivalentLanguages & travel
• English: strong professional proficiency
• Dutch and French: required
• Comfortable working with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Willing to travel internationally for short assignments of 5–10 days, approximately 1–2 times per year.

Responsibilities

• Inventory, map, and classify critical data assets along with their associated flows and dependencies.
• Define and implement data management policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
• Establish data protection requirements and access rules based on classification and the principle of least privilege.
• Facilitate training and awareness sessions to drive the adoption of data governance principles and best practices.
• Ensure data quality, discoverability, and documentation through master data management and lineage modeling.

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in Data Governance and Data Quality management.
• Strong understanding of DAMA-DMBOK or similar data governance frameworks.
• Practical experience with governance and metadata management tools such as Collibra, Informatica, or OvalEdge.
• Proven track record in Change Management and technical documentation within complex environments.
• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills to align business and IT objectives.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with professional proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of NIS2 regulations and standards such as ISO/IEC 38505, ISO 8000, or GDPR.
• Knowledge of data modeling using UML or Archimate.
• Professional experience within regulated sectors like finance or the public sector.

What makes this role interesting?

You’ll be involved from A to Z:

•  Prepare and test solutions in the lab
•  Implement new installations at customer sites
•  Configure and manage complex UC/IT environments
•  Troubleshoot technical challenges
•  Perform upgrades, maintenance and lifecycle management
•  Support customers remotely and on-site
•  Give technical demos and customer training
•  Work with experienced colleagues on high-end technology projects
And because technology never stands still, you’ll continuously get the opportunity to learn new technologies and expand your expertise.

 

 Your technical playground

You’ll feel at home if you have experience with several of these:

• Enterprise Voice / Unified Communications
• Cisco networking / CCNA
• Windows Server
• Linux
• VMware and/or Nutanix
• Voice & Video technologies
• IT infrastructure & system engineering
You don’t have to know everything. Curiosity and the drive to learn matter just as much as your current skillset.

 

You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented.

You take ownership, enjoy working independently but also know the value of a strong team.

You’re service-minded, flexible and customer-focused, and you’re comfortable communicating with both technical colleagues and customers.

You have:

• A Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences – Electronics/ICT or ICT, or
• A Bachelor’s degree in Electronics/ICT + 3–5 years of relevant experience
• Good knowledge of networking and Windows Server environments
• Experience with Enterprise Voice / UC is a strong plus
• Fluency in Dutch and French, and good knowledge of English
• A driving licence B

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy M/W/X
jobs.description:
At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.

 

The  Analytical Science team in Seneffe  is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.

 

 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in Seneffe, Belgium. 

 

 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation. 

 

 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously. 

Responsibilities 

 

 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 
 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 
 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 
 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 
 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 
 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 
 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines. 
 
 
Qualifications 

 

 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 
 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 
 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 
 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 
 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 
 

 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 
 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage. 
 

 

 

Your Skills 

 

 

• Strong scientific problem-solving and critical thinking capabilities. 
 

• Expertise in interpreting complex analytical data and translating findings into actionable insights. 
 

• Creativity combined with a practical, hands-on approach to experimentation and troubleshooting. 
 

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while delivering high-quality results. 
 

• Excellent communication, technical writing, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. 
 

• Ability to work effectively in diverse, global, and cross-functional teams. 
 

• Learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and commitment to continuous development. 
 

• Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering innovative solutions. 
 

• Strong digital proficiency and ability to leverage analytical tools and technologies. 
 

• Passion for chemistry, materials science, polymers, and industrial research.  
Benefits - What Dow offers you 

 

We invest in you. 
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.  

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.

• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• You work accurately and value order and structure	
• Safety is always your top priority	
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
At Llbg, our core business processes depend on seamless integrations between SAP, cloud applications, data platforms, customers and suppliers. As an Integration Engineer, you play a key role in designing, building and supporting the integrations and automations that connect these systems.

Working primarily with Workato, you help ensure our critical business processes run efficiently, reliably and securely. You combine technical expertise with a problem-solving mindset and contribute to scalable, future-proof solutions that support our continued growth and digital transformation.
Function

• You design, build, test, deploy and support enterprise integrations and process automations on the Workato platform.

• You translate business requirements into reliable and scalable integration solutions while adhering to Llbg's architecture and integration standards.

• You integrate SAP applications with many other business-critical systems such as Microsoft 365, cloud applications, data platforms and external B2B interfaces

• You monitor integration flows, handle incidents, perform root cause analyses and continuously improve solutions to ensure stable business operations.

• You develop and maintain reusable components, technical documentation, test scenarios and operational procedures that support long-term maintainability.

• You collaborate closely with architects, developers, business analysts and external partners to deliver scalable, sustainable and supportable solutions.

• You contribute to the further development of intelligent automation and AI-enabled solutions, ensuring they are secure, reliable and deliver measurable business value.

• You help drive continuous improvement of the integration platform by promoting best practices, identifying optimization opportunities and contributing to reusable standards and governance.

• As Integration Engineer you will report to the Integration Architect.

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering or a related field, or have gained equivalent experience.

• You have an affinity with, and basic understanding of integration concepts through study, internship, personal projects, or professional experience.

• Prior exposure to an iPaaS platform (Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite, Azure Integration Services) is a strong plus but not required.

• You have some familiarity with at least a few of the following, and are eager to deepen your knowledge on the job:

• Integration principles and patterns (sync/async communication, event-driven architecture)

• API technologies (REST, SOAP, GraphQL)

• Security concepts (authentication, authorization, API security)

• Data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, CSV, data mapping)

• Monitoring, logging, and error handling in system integrations

• You can communicate fluently in English and Dutch.

• You enjoy working with both technical and business stakeholders in an international environment.
